001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
011import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
012
013/**
014 *
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017@Deprecated
018public class PropSetBounded extends Propagator<Variable> {
019
020    private final IntVar from, to;
021    private final SetVar set;
022
023    public PropSetBounded(IntVar from, IntVar to, SetVar set) {
024        super(new Variable[]{from, to, set}, PropagatorPriority.BINARY, false);
025        this.from = from;
026        this.to = to;
027        this.set = set;
028    }
029
030    boolean isFromVar(int idx) {
031        return idx == 0;
032    }
033
034    boolean isToVar(int idx) {
035        return idx == 1;
036    }
037
038    boolean isSetVar(int idx) {
039        return idx == 2;
040    }
041
042    @Override
043    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
044        if (isFromVar(vIdx)) {
045            return IntEventType.INSTANTIATE.getMask() + IntEventType.DECUPP.getMask();
046        }
047        if (isToVar(vIdx)) {
048            return IntEventType.INSTANTIATE.getMask() + IntEventType.INCLOW.getMask();
049        }
050        assert isSetVar(vIdx);
051        return SetEventType.all();
052    }
053
054    @Override
055    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
056        from.updateUpperBound(to.getUB(), this);
057        to.updateLowerBound(from.getLB(), this);
058        if (from.getUB() < to.getLB() && !set.getUB().isEmpty()) {
059            from.updateLowerBound(set.getUB().min(), this);
060            to.updateUpperBound(set.getUB().max() + 1, this);
061        }
062        int f = from.getUB();
063        int t = to.getLB();
064        for (int i = f; i < t; i++) {
065            set.force(i, this);
066        }
067    }
068
069    @Override
070    public ESat isEntailed() {
071        if (from.getLB() > to.getUB()) {
072            return ESat.FALSE;
073        }
074        int f = from.getUB();
075        int t = to.getLB();
076        if (t - f > set.getUB().size()) {
077            return ESat.FALSE;
078        }
079        for (int i = f; i < t; i++) {
080            if (!set.getUB().contains(i)) {
081                return ESat.FALSE;
082            }
083        }
084        return to.isInstantiated() && from.isInstantiated() && set.isInstantiated()
085                ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
086    }
087}
